outcome: Adherence to total and trimester-specific GWG recommendations
Area under the curve (AUC) for GWG
cohort: The study included 44,801 pregnant people from community-based health care organizations, representing underserved demographic subgroups such as people of color, those with larger body sizes, or lower incomes.
finding: GWG metrics, including total GWG, trimester-specific rates, and z-scores, differ significantly across pre-pregnancy BMI categories, with notable first trimester weight loss in individuals with class II or III obesity and substantial first trimester weight gain in those who are underweight.
